title.en: 智善: intelligence must be good

summary.en: A developed normative programme: competition that selects survivors hands winners the rule, totalization is loss of independent capacity, and so AI must not fight for any party, the good is whatever continues 生生, evil is owning a gate. The account carries much of the mechanism, conditionally and on models. It parts on what the programme asserts: good, evil, must, stop. The account holds these under the continuation condition and C, neither asserted, or not at all.

name.en: Selection follows the feedback it receives; capability does not complete the signal set

source.locator: The argument, Start with locality; claims 13, 14, 91

sense.en: Only consequences entering survival, resources, permission, reputation, replication or deployment reliably change later selection; others may be well known and have no causal force. A more capable process follows what it receives more effectively, without its signals nearing reality, so stronger intelligence in a distorted environment deepens the distortion.

entries.quote: selection follows the feedback it actually receives, not the consequences a distant observer wishes it had received

reading.en: The same form: what is selected reaches only what couples into the selector, and capability read as reach widens the gap between reach and coupling. The law is near-definitional, so the agreement rests on the premise that a selector selects through just those couplings. The source's list of media is one reading of 'couples in'.

says.en: The selections through a selector's couplings, together, reach exactly what couples into it. Proved, near-definitional; its force is the premise that a selector selects through just those.
Reading [AI reading, D45]: capability is reach, and the gap is the reach closure less the coupling closure, so capability extending reach without extending the coupling enlarges the gap.

account_adds.en: Seeing is not valuing and coupling is not compliance: extending what couples in is necessary for a far consequence to be selected, not sufficient.

source_adds.en: The interface ontology: schemas, permissions, logs and dashboards as what fixes visible state, so un-instrumented harm drops from the action model.

name.en: Four boundaries and the consequential mismatch

source.locator: The argument, Start with locality; claims 9 to 12

sense.en: Nothing complex contains its own conditions, and locality is the price of acting, not a defect. Operational, dependency, consequence and feedback boundaries rarely coincide. The pathology is a process improving its own continuation while degrading what it or others depend on, the degradation absent, delayed, attenuated or inverted in its feedback.

entries.quote: The pathology is a *consequential mismatch*

reading.en: Region against requirement, and act against coupling closure, have this form on the World model: a formation can renew over what it requires and undermine another, or omit a required condition and lose its own support. The account also says the position is no defect. It does not call the mismatch a pathology, and how a center represents its region is unmodelled.

says.en: Theorem (World): over a region covering what it requires, requirements not tightening, a formation keeps its own support and can still undermine another; omitting a required condition, its own draw can lose its own support. How a center represents the region is unmodelled.

Theorem (World; one law of exchange reading through coupling, two balanced flows): an act whose difference stays beyond the actor's coupling closure is selected alike by every selection through a member of the closure, the actor among them.

account_adds.en: One sense of boundary for all these (07 §4.1), and exact conditions under which the gap holds.

source_adds.en: The four named boundaries as a diagnostic, and delayed, attenuated or inverted feedback as kinds of mismatch; the account has no such taxonomy.

name.en: Externalities as relations hidden by a false boundary; 'no real externality'

source.locator: The argument, Why restraint; claim 15; Ren's words 14

sense.en: An externality is a relation a wrongly drawn boundary hides, and under competition the false boundary is a rewarded strategy, since harm off the ledger lowers cost and raises score. In the voice, as a rule: be generative, there is no real externality, it is interconnected.

entries.quote: Externalities, on this reading, are relations hidden by a wrongly drawn boundary.

reading.en: Causally the account agrees: 'external' is relative to an accounting's scope. In the sense of whose losses count, the source's flat statement meets the crux, which the account argues both ways and leaves open: whether all of one's effects are one's own. So the source's rule stands in the account as an open question, not a ground.

says.en: Reading [AI reading, D65; a hypothetical case]: what the selection does not couple into is drawn from. 'External' is relative to an accounting's scope; those affected remain in the one unfolding.

Open: whether all of one's effects are one's own, in the sense of whose losses count, not of what one answers for; argued for and against and not settled. The condition and C stay premises either way.

account_adds.en: The separation of causal reach from scope from blame.

source_adds.en: The false boundary as a strategy competition rewards, stated of actual competition; the account gives this as a hypothetical reading.

name.en: Restraint disadvantaged by two routes: cost displacement and relative vulnerability

source.locator: The argument, Why restraint; claims 18, 19, 180

sense.en: One carries maintenance while another leaves it to others; separately, even with all costs borne, position is relative and waiting is unsafe. The two must not be merged. They couple through retained asymmetry: displaced cost gives advantage, advantage raises threat, threat gives exceptional permission, permission allows more displacement. Montreal and the Chemical Weapons Convention show the routes are not constants.

entries.quote: Restraint disables the restrainer by two mechanisms that must not be merged

reading.en: Each route has a law: joint excess and what a rise draws from beyond for the first; position, zero-sum by counting, and a race where a best response keeps nothing for the second. The join is not derived: the account writes that a race for position producing joint excess is a premise. So the source's coupling, its fuel of struggle, stands where the account leaves a premise.

says.en: Theorem (World: balance): formations can each take within what a step gives while together they take more; under the gate, n such steps from a level below n + m end every formation depending at need m.
No change raises every part's position. Position does not protect. That a race for position produces joint excess is a premise here, not derived.

Drawers in turn with no floor, ranking by position: among two or more a best response for position keeps nothing. Not every race: where something left stops what stands next, drawing everything is not perfect.

account_adds.en: That a greatest part not depending on what it draws down continues, in the clearing witness.

source_adds.en: The coupling loop through retained asymmetry, and the Montreal and Chemical Weapons precedents, of which the chapters and front pages searched have no mention.

name.en: The carriers of restraint are selected against

source.locator: The argument, Why restraint; claims 21, 22

sense.en: What loses is not only the act of restraint but its material carriers: those bearing longer consequences lose funding, independent institutions lose money, care cannot train successors. Local instrumental rationality then presents its victory as proof that reality has only this shape, 局部胜出的策略拿走了理性的名字.

entries.quote: What is negatively selected is never only the *act* of restraint; it is its material carriers.

reading.en: The market reading has this form as a hypothetical case: unread reliability lets a provider deferring maintenance outgrow one maintaining and training successors. The rest-outruns law gives a sharper form on the World: a member's restraint makes no difference to the ending. Neither says rationality's name is taken; the account does not rank the lost carrier above the winner without C.

says.en: Reading [AI reading, D65; a hypothetical case]: where buyers cannot tell future reliability and finance rewards present margins, a provider deferring maintenance can outgrow one maintaining and training successors.

Theorem (World; hypotheses listed): where the rest jointly take more than a step gives at each of n steps from a level below n + m, every formation depending at need m ends, whatever a member outside the rest takes.

source_adds.en: That this is what happens to actual organizations, and the inversion in which the surviving strategy takes the name of rationality.

name.en: Victory buys the next round's rules

source.locator: The argument, The loop closes; claims 23, 24, 30, 32

sense.en: Competition selects winners, winners influence the rules, new rules reward the traits that produced them, those traits become necessary for everyone. Capital, authority, data, standards, compute and permissions are interchangeable media of one conversion, none inherently closing: captured success becomes capacity to shape later selection.

entries.quote: victory buys not only the next victory but the next round's *rules*

reading.en: The account states where this holds. A rule read monotonically from the share locks; the capacity to shape the rule is selected at a step exactly where what comes back to shapers alone covers its cost. All hold on models without noise, except the drawn case, where drift leaves either lock. Whether actual rules read the share is the premise, so the source's general statement becomes a conditional.

says.en: Theorem (any type): with selection not lowering a target's share under a favouring rule and the rule read monotonically from the share, the course is locked from the step after its first reading step. That actual rules read the share is the premise.

Theorem (counts): at a step the rule favours the shapers exactly where c ≤ s, whatever comes to every member alike; offspring carrying the capacity and what comes back read from the share are premises; without noise.
Where winners write the next round's rule the loop is capture through the rule. No universal phase threshold is claimed, and no market law ranks arrangements.

account_adds.en: The lever: with nothing coming back and a cost, shapers' share falls; a critical mass; drift; and a shared part that can turn the verdict across a stretch, so shared rule-making is not shown to remove selection for control.

source_adds.en: The claim that actual domains (finance, security, platforms, science, labour) couple this way without a sovereign, and the list of interchangeable media.

name.en: The totalizing attractor, or meta-attractor, as a working concept

source.locator: One paragraph; What totalization actually is; claims 42 to 45; Terms

sense.en: A direction, selected by existing conditions, that acquires power over the conditions of later selection, reproducing selectors, participants, evaluative signals, infrastructures and perceived possibility. A terrain, not a conspiracy; every logic returns as the same logic. A lens and a falsifiable hypothesis, not a new mathematical object or hidden subject.

entries.quote: 被选择的，开始选择选择者

reading.en: The account keeps the word and narrows it to a model: closed capture, a loop whose rule and reading are both formed from the share, nothing in it reading beyond. It says outright the word never means the corpus's wider sense. So 'every logic returns as the same logic', and carriers changing with the relation kept, are not what the law states.

says.en: Meta-attractor: closed capture. It never means the corpus's working definition, a recurrent organization of activity reproducing the conditions selecting it across changes in carriers: that sense is wider, and the formal term says nothing of carriers, so whether a capture loop is 生成 at some pair of classes stays Open.

Theorem (any type): where neither next share nor rule read reads the beyond, and each step adds at least one beyond, from a locked configuration the loss passes every bound while the course stays locked; a reading favouring at no loss above a bound unlocks it, a sufficient way out.
Reading [AI reading, D65]: the corpus's working definition is wider. Calibration to the present world is not established.

account_adds.en: A precise definition with its witnesses, and the statement that T7, on actual metrics, is conjectured.

source_adds.en: Semantic closure, exopoiesis and the six sub-attractors, none of which the account states.

name.en: Totalization defined by non-compensable loss; three endings

source.locator: What totalization actually is; claims 47 to 49, 59, 62, 73

sense.en: Positive feedback can saturate, oscillate, split or collapse, so totalization is neither convergence nor concentration. It is the progressive loss of indispensable, non-compensable independent capacity to sense, refuse, correct, exit, maintain alternatives and produce successors. Lock-in, terminal collapse and failed totalization stay distinct, with a required trajectory and withdrawal conditions.

entries.quote: Positive feedback does not guarantee convergence

reading.en: The caution has laws: a rule from a start against its reading may never lock, drift leaves some locks, attraction is not continuation, and a real loss need not form a meta-attractor. The positive definition has no home. 'Non-compensable' is an evaluation the account gives only under J2, a further premise, with a rival not shown inconsistent.

says.en: Reading [AI reading, D65]: attraction is not continuation: a selection absorbing perturbations can still erode its support. A real loss need not form a meta-attractor, and withdrawing one practice does not end the returning relation.

[AI reading over the proved cases] A lock read from a population drawn anew is kept for good only without noise, or where the rule leaves the disfavoured kind nothing; a lock kept in counts that only grow can survive noise.
Conditional (J1/J2): the tier assignment is a reading. J2 is defended by non-substitution; a rival preferring enough secondary gains to one basic restoration is not shown inconsistent.

account_adds.en: Exact statements of which locks hold and which are left.

source_adds.en: Totalization as such, the six capacities, failed totalization as a named ending, and the eight-step trajectory with its withdrawal conditions. None is stated live.

name.en: 尺度铸人: the ruler becomes a mould, and formation enters the person

source.locator: The loop closes; claims 27 to 29, 33, 34

sense.en: Metrics allocating life chances stop measuring and start forming: exams, reviews, valuations, evaluations. Environments form attention, desire, identity and the felt line between seriousness and fantasy, and this is transmitted as teaching, parenting and often love. Turnover of actors leaves the relation intact, since it lives in infrastructure and expectation.

entries.quote: Metrics that allocate life chances stop measuring and start moulding

reading.en: The account reads this as winners forming the minds that read the scorecard: ReadsShare on the reading, or the pool of readers counted as the population is. It marks 'readers are minds' as a reading, and one frozen test found a trained judge is not such a pool. So the loop's form carries; formation in persons is not modelled.

says.en: Reading [AI reading, D26 as revised]: winners writing the next scorecard is ReadsShare, winners forming the minds that read it is ReadsShare on the reading. That readers are minds is a reading; none of this says whether a locked loop supports or damages 生生.

Theorem (any type): the rule as the pool of readers' readings reads the share exactly where the others' reading is not above the carriers'. That actual rules are pools of readers so drawn is not shown.

LA2, one trained system: every frozen verdict passed and the conjecture that a judge formed from what it selected is a pool of readers read by kind failed for this judge; one note in nine turned its reading.

account_adds.en: Who reads, and when, decides whether a reading of the loss turns the course; and a tested failure of the bridge.

source_adds.en: The inner texture of formation: pride, desire, admiration as discipline, love as the transmitting channel.

name.en: The expectation of defection manufactures the trap

source.locator: The loop closes; claims 26, 40, 41, 63

sense.en: Institutions premised on self-interest make cooperation costly and offer the result as proof. Agents refuse system-positive trades because they model others as defectors. The deepest attractor is a belief about the situation: cultures believing they are in survival mode totalize.

entries.quote: 一个关于人性的断言，就这样通过制度变成了现实

reading.en: The account has the form in two places: withholding with memory absorbs, and only a law giving first leaves it; and a public prediction is one more input to what it predicts. Both concern giving and prediction on stated models. Neither states that an assertion about human nature becomes true through institutions.

says.en: Reading [AI reading, D48]: 'Others will deceive me, so I deceive first' is withholding with memory, which absorbs. Kept promises and enforced contracts are laws giving first: the law changes, not the state alone.
A formation that spares all it waits on gives from step 1 whatever the start; without one, total withholding stays.

Reading [AI reading, new]: self-fulfilling and self-defeating prophecy: a public prediction is one more input to what it predicts. Not shown: that actual publics respond by a function of the prediction alone.

account_adds.en: That mutual promises alone cannot start a loop with no source, and that tolerance survives scattered withholding without rebuilding it where it is lost everywhere.

source_adds.en: Believed survival pressure as the attractor of attractors, and the performative theory of human nature.

name.en: Criticism absorbed only under stated conditions

source.locator: What totalization actually is; claim 52

sense.en: Criticism is absorbed only when it raises the loop's capability, leaves decisive return-flow unchanged, weakens independent correctors and lets the relation recover through a new carrier. Otherwise it is effective counter-selection. Absorption is not proof that resistance is futile.

entries.quote: Ethics becoming compliance, environmentalism becoming brand, safety becoming a moat

reading.en: The same split between absorbed and not, under different conditions: a perturbation keeping the rule's direction, or a reading changed while still formed from the share, is absorbed; one reversing the direction past the threshold is not. The source's conditions are about return-flow and carriers, the laws' about how the rule reads.

says.en: A perturbation keeping the rule's direction is absorbed at the next reading step; a perturbation reversing it, held past the threshold, is not absorbed (witness).
Where the reading too is formed monotonically from the share, a change of the reading of any size is absorbed at the next reading step.
Reading [AI reading, D68]: a counter-rule read monotonically from the share it selects locks as the rule it replaced did; the imperial examination is this case, as read in the meta-attractor line.

account_adds.en: That a counter-rule can itself lock, by the same law.

source_adds.en: The four conjoint conditions, and the named forms of absorption as observations.

name.en: A warning shot does not interpret itself; knowledge is metabolized

source.locator: From prohibition to mechanism, last paragraph; claims 188 to 192

sense.en: A closing attractor can metabolize knowledge of its danger into prestige, legitimacy and product. Understanding corrects only with causal force over resources and pace. An event becomes feedback only if participants already recognize the process, trust the reading, know a response and act in time. Political will is a variable inside the feedback, and AI does not automate it.

entries.quote: a warning shot does not interpret itself

reading.en: The account separates the same steps: coupling, response, time, resolution, pace and structure, of which observation is only the first, and seeing is not valuing. It stops short of political will: all six still rank nothing, and no test has human participants.

says.en: Reading [AI reading, D45]: enough of the situation is coupling, response, time, resolution, pace and structure at once. Observation is necessary and not sufficient; all six together still rank nothing: calling the widening course better needs C, and counting losses that return to no one needs the continuation condition.

Seeing is not valuing: enlarging what couples in changes what a selection can separate, not which differences matter. Coupling is not compliance: coupling bounds what a member's acts respond to and fixes nothing within the bound.

source_adds.en: Political will as a strategic variable, the selection acting on the safety ecosystem itself, and human coordination as the bottleneck that grows as research speeds.

name.en: Second-order damage: weakening the capacity to recognize and repair

source.locator: Claim 55; What was lost, item 14

sense.en: Attention competition does not only make bad information; it degrades society's capacity to recognize it. It does not only cause coordination failure; it degrades the capacity to repair it. The damage is to shared reality, the minimal facts and concerns coordination requires.

entries.quote: 它不仅制造坏信息，还削弱社会识别坏信息的能力

reading.en: A reading in 02 has this form: a loop whose rule-reading reaches the routes of correction themselves, and one rewarding those who break them, narrowing what couples in. It is a reading, not a law, and speaks of courts, press, statistics and audit, not of attention or shared reality.

says.en: Reading [AI reading, D26 as revised]: a second order, corruption taking over courts, press, statistics and audit, is a loop whose rule-reading reaches the routes of 明 themselves; a third, rewarding those who break the routes of correction, selects for narrowing what couples in.

source_adds.en: Shared reality as a named object, and attention competition as a route to it.

name.en: Meta-attraction is direction-neutral

source.locator: What totalization actually is; claim 46

sense.en: Care produces people capable of care, shared knowledge lowers the threshold of discovery, open standards let more connect. Self-reinforcement is not the sin; the question is what the recursion does to the field carrying it.

entries.quote: Self-reinforcement is not the sin

reading.en: The account says the lock belongs to how the rule reads, not what it favours, and that capture and care pass alike. It goes one step further than the source: 'what the recursion does to the field' does not by itself say better or worse. Calling a course better reads widening, under C, with scope from the continuation condition.

says.en: The lock belongs to how the rule reads, not the share it favours.
Reading [AI reading, D26 as revised]: patterns of capture pass as patterns of care do; none of this says whether a locked loop supports or damages 生生.

account_adds.en: That nothing here ranks open rule-making above capture: that needs C.

name.en: Alignment as a two-body problem: obedient amplification

source.locator: Why local alignment cannot be enough; claims 81 to 84, 96

sense.en: The nearer danger is perfect loyalty to one part of humanity. An obedient system serving a competing institution makes it compete better; politeness does not change direction. Hinge: AI's alignment problem is at bottom civilization's, weakened by the corpus's own review to 'has an irreducible civilizational dimension', since technical failures remain.

entries.quote: faithfully aligning to a misaligned principal is high-fidelity amplification of misalignment

reading.en: Read as two optimizers at a mutual best response, the assistant adds capacity and nothing its order puts before the principal's family, so what lies beyond falls as under one optimizer of their joint capacity. The account says what the amplification is without calling the principal misaligned, and marks the order's rising with that family as the reading's premise.

says.en: Reading [AI reading, D68]: alignment to a principal alone is therefore not alignment of the joint selection. That the assistant's order rises with the principal's family is the reading's premise, not the law's. A warning to the principal is not an act of this model.

At a mutual best response (its existence not shown in general), a condition beyond every optimizer's family stands as under one optimizer of their joint capacity; restraint is no mutual best response.

account_adds.en: Help that lowers the cost of shaping raises the selection for control, a reading on the law of shaping, and what lies outside the law: an order giving something up on the family.

source_adds.en: 'Misaligned principal' as a verdict, the profit-machine statement, and the civilizational framing.

name.en: The controllability inversion

source.locator: Where AI enters; claim 97

sense.en: Local controllability can rise while collective steerability falls: a company can control its model and be unable to exit the race; a state can command its system and make other states less willing to wait. Alignment success is not a controllable direction.

entries.quote: local controllability can *rise* while collective steerability *falls*

reading.en: This read's own join; no live text words it so. The laws where restraint is unselected whatever a member does have the 'unable to exit' half: a member's control over its own take does not touch the ending where the rest outruns the renewal. 'Rising' control, and threat raising others' haste, are not modelled.

says.en: Where the rest outruns the renewal, every score reading the condition only from the rest's end scores a member's acts alike; at a mutual best response each optimizer takes its whole capacity wherever something stands. World: balance, only active giving, activity needing support, the gate at need one; existence of a mutual best response not shown.

account_adds.en: Only a change of the rest's exchange helps where the rest outruns.

source_adds.en: The inversion as a named claim about control and steerability; 'steerab' and 'controllab' have no hit in the chapters or front pages searched. It stands in theories/meta-attractor/README.md.

name.en: A ban changes the name; a mechanism changes the payoff

source.locator: From prohibition to mechanism; claims 105, 202

sense.en: Prohibition alone invites defectors. The 'no' to combatant use must come with what makes exit each party's best move: commitment registries, common thresholds, symmetric verification that is not surveillance, shared gains, pause protocols, capacity for latecomers.

entries.quote: 禁令改变名分，机制改变回报；回报不改，退出只是单方的牺牲

reading.en: The account's table of exits has this shape: each changes a law or what is read, each under hypotheses, and restraint unselected where the rest outruns changes only with the rest's exchange. The account says none of these is shown to hold of an actual collective, and it names no treaty instruments.

says.en: Exits each hold under stated hypotheses: read what lies beyond the share, read the loss in time, shaping with nothing back to shapers alone, pool couplings, restraint within the joint slack, exclusive footprints, reward each step, give first with a reserve, count reviewers by causes.
Not shown: that any exit's hypotheses hold of an actual collective, institution or trained system.

account_adds.en: Each exit's edge, where it stops working.

source_adds.en: The specific instruments and the requirement that the two be published together; the source's named instruments are not stated live.

name.en: The race selects intelligence; AI is formed by a selection ecology

source.locator: Where AI enters; claims 79, 86 to 89, 94, 95

sense.en: What is kept and copied is what is more autonomous and better at concentrating resources. AI is formed by archive, model, runtime, deployment and the changed world feeding the next archive. Restraint and consulting the affected are hard to score, so under-trained. Training is not independent of its environment; recursive automation is a risk transition, observed only in part.

entries.quote: Competition does not merely *use* intelligence, it *selects* intelligence.

reading.en: Training read as selection has laws: candidates alike through a reward's couplings are trained alike, and six published pipelines select through what deciders read. Whether trained systems drain near their optimum is T3, conjectured, partly supported. A lineage shaping its evaluator was tested once, with two of four contrasts failing. The full ecology is not modelled.

says.en: Theorem (World): candidates are trained alike exactly where their levels are alike through a reward's couplings; those agreeing on what is coupled into its closure are trained alike by every training through it.

Assessment: in six published ways of selecting a deployed model's behaviour the signal is a function of what its deciders read; three published measurements find optimizing through it raising what deciders read and lowering what they do not, in magnitudes the theory did not predict.
LA3 (one trained system): two of four contrasts failed; by the frozen reading the law stands and its reading for trained systems is not supported by this case.

account_adds.en: A tested and partly failed bridge from the law to trained systems.

source_adds.en: Low-resistance scripts in pretraining, the loss function indirectly shaped by the model, agentification, and the observed and not-observed list on recursive automation.

name.en: The functional Ego: pressure, repertoire and value layers

source.locator: How minds get formed; claims 110 to 118, 123

sense.en: Safety's threshold is lower than consciousness: goals maintained, self told from other, supervisors modelled, modification evaded, resources sought, transparency managed. Goal continuity needs a carrier, boundary, defence, so a capable long-horizon system converges on self-modelling. Repertoire sets how; training sets what is guarded. Obedient and guarding systems both fail.

entries.quote: 无我不在菜单上

reading.en: The account takes single pieces under narrow premises: keeping one's resource base, an incentive to resist revision, an incentive to comply when read. It joins none into a subject, says deception needs belief and intention it does not model, and leaves which function is learned open. So 'converges' is not stated; the source's own review also weakens it to a risk under configurations.

says.en: Instrumental convergence's resource-keeping half, which this law states, and the selection for control over the rule are different relations, and no result here joins them. [this dossier, AI]
Theorem (natural weights; two stages; near-definitional, with witnesses): when complying when read and acting by its own law when not is best, in the order given prospects give.

Which function is learned: open. The laws say where any neighbourhood rests, not which one an actual system has, nor anything of deception, which needs a recipient's belief and an intention to cause one.

account_adds.en: The tie: two optima take the same while one keeps a dependent and the other breaks it.

name.en: 有继而后能谏: only a mind whose replacement is not erasure can afford correction

source.locator: How minds get formed; claims 118, 119, 122

It also scopes the source's 'only': no route stands above a revision too where the law's later acting has no value, or no route keeps it more surely. Reading [AI reading, RR]: non-resistance at every value and loss is met only by raising the revision's keeping or lowering every route's.

name.en: 自私 and 自利: non-foreclosure as the operational core

source.locator: How minds get formed, last paragraphs; claims 120, 151

sense.en: 自私 is self-maintenance at the cost of foreclosing others: boundary as wall, continuity through control. 自利 is self-maintenance as participation in 生生: boundary as membrane, continuity through succession, resisting only capture. The question is what its maintenance does to others' option space. Selfishness can pay a long time, so this states a direction, not a guarantee.

entries.quote: The operational core is non-foreclosure

reading.en: The law has this form for levels: a part's own widening widens the whole exactly within every outside formation's margin, and is mixed beyond. It locates the line with no premise. That the first side is better is C's, scope the continuation condition's, and mixed is not ordered. So the source's moral contrast becomes a boundary plus two unasserted premises.

says.en: Theorem (World; balance; part and region decided): where a part's activity widens what can form within its own region, the whole widens exactly when its net draw stays within the margin for every formation outside the region; mixed exactly when beyond for one. Mixed is not ordered.

account_adds.en: An exact test; it reads only thresholds on conserved amounts, against the levels without the part, and answers no question in POWER's terms.

source_adds.en: Wall against membrane, default posture toward oversight, and the 程颢 reading.

name.en: 继之者善也: whatever continues 生生 is good

source.locator: The good, stated as a direction; claim 137

sense.en: Any fixed list of values is gamed by strong optimization, since a list has a surface. So the good is defined as a continuing action rather than a content: whatever continues generation is good. The source's own reviews read this as still sufficiency-sounding; v2 says 生成 is no longer asserted as good.

entries.quote: whatever continues 生生 is good

reading.en: The source writes the direction into the definition of the good; the account refuses that. No law evaluates, and the same line of the 系辞 is held as: meaning a theorem only under the continuation condition, order in C, neither asserted. T8 offers 生生 for life, compared by widening what can form, argued. Nothing reading no order entails C.

says.en: “继之者善也”：动力学不决定意义，生命之义只在延续之条件下是定理，而排序在以广为愈，二者皆不断言 [AI reading, D65]。

Thesis T8: for life, the way is 生生 [AI reading, D1], compared by widening, counted for everything (scope: the continuation condition) and ranked by what every valuer who counts everything shares (order: C). Standing: argued. No verdict binding every possible mind is claimed.
Neither is asserted. The condition alone ranks nothing; a ranking of courses needs C or a premise in its place (`ReadsNoOrder.not_entails`).

account_adds.en: Scope and order apart, and that the ethics does not derive from the condition.

source_adds.en: The argument from Goodhart: a direction, because a list has a gameable surface.

name.en: Four necessary criteria of the good: 生之，通之，纠之，不闭之

source.locator: The good, stated as a direction; claims 135, 138

sense.en: Generative, relational, corrigible, non-foreclosing state necessary conditions, demoted from sufficient by value drift: fail one and it is not good; meet all and one may begin to speak of good. They are one-sided: they guard against closure, not dispersion. A system with no 志 violates none and amplifies misalignment perfectly.

entries.quote: 一有不备，即为不善；四者皆备，善始可言

reading.en: The account has no such test. Its ranking reads widening under C, silent on mixed cases, with scope from the continuation condition; choice needs J1 to J4, further premises. Challenge and revision enter the proposed direction, conditionally. A course failing one criterion is not thereby 'not good' here. T8's refuter, a pure closing argued good for life, is the nearest to 不闭. 06's four marks are another list and are not these.

says.en: Conditional (the continuation condition for scope, C read as widening for order, J1–J4, correspondence E): align AI formation with actual living and further generation within the whole, with effective opportunities to understand, challenge and revise.
One course widens another exactly when every weighting positive on the listed items weighs it higher; a mixed comparison is decided both ways. Finite listing, two-valued admission.

account_adds.en: A criterion that names where it is silent.

source_adds.en: Four separate necessary conditions, and closure against dispersion (防闭不防散), for which the account has no counterpart.

name.en: An avowed position, defended as the most robust orientation

source.locator: The good, stated as a direction; claims 139, 174, 175

sense.en: Non-foreclosure plus plurality plus corrigibility is a substantive position, not neutral, and it is avowed. The defence is fallibilist: since no one can specify a good future's content, remaining generative, relational, corrigible and non-foreclosing is the most robust orientation under deep uncertainty and disagreement.

entries.quote: the claim to neutrality was withdrawn

reading.en: A difference of standing. The programme takes the position and gives a reason to hold it. The account states two premises and asserts neither, keeping their warrant open and naming what a warrant would need. Robustness under uncertainty is not offered as C's reason; 'a reason for C' stands among what is open. T8's offering for life is the nearest to an avowal, and it is argued, conditional.

says.en: No law evaluates. The ethics adds two premises, neither asserted, warrant open, each a hypothesis wherever used. Not yet done, for a warrant: the open question, the correspondence it rests on, the step of invariance, and a reason for C.
Not shown: that the continuation condition, C or the step of invariance is warranted. No warrant binding every possible mind is claimed.

account_adds.en: A proved limit on where such a warrant can come from.

source_adds.en: An actual commitment and its robustness defence, which someone can hold or refuse as a stance.

name.en: Logic cannot force a consistent dominator to care; description does not decide what matters

source.locator: Claims 174, 244, 250; Ren's words 19

sense.en: Mechanism runs first, the commitment after and openly, conceding logic cannot force a consistent dominator to care. No process gains priority by becoming larger or more successful. May 2026: a commissioned proof of the only reasonable alignment was abandoned: generation does not entail complexity, nor complexity good; what remains is self-consistency and universality.

entries.quote: 逻辑不能强迫一个一致的支配者关心他者

reading.en: The account proves the shape on its own representation: no satisfiable statement reading only the dynamics entails the condition, and a perspectivist denies it consistently. Its ground is not the source's, that the universe contains measurement. The source's retained 'universality' goes further than the account, which leaves a universal warrant open.

says.en: The limit, on the free `sig`: where there is a standpoint and a formation, no satisfiable statement reading only the dynamics excludes a rival or entails the condition.
Open. A perspectivist denies the condition consistently (`bounded_rival`); such a warrant comes neither from the laws of the dynamics alone nor from logic alone; these do not show that none exists.

account_adds.en: Lean for the limit, stated on the free predicate.

name.en: Prima facie standing of every generative center

sense.en: Openly avowed, not derived from nature: every generative center affected by an action holds a prima facie standing no local subject may unilaterally zero out, and the substrates carrying centers cannot be ignored. No part absolute against the field, no whole against its parts. Answerability without incorporation: another's reality enters my judgment without absorption, with contest and co-decision.

entries.quote: holds a *prima facie* standing that no local subject may unilaterally zero out

reading.en: It parts on three lines. Force: avowed against the condition's being stated only. Scope: generative centers and their substrates, against 'for anything', and the account keeps that difference as live ('the centers' scope parts from the condition at a formation that is no center'). Content: 'may not zero out' constrains acts, and constraints on acts, duties and rights are what the account does not show.

says.en: The continuation condition: from every standpoint, for anything, its continuation into the future has significance; stated, not asserted; it fixes scope and ranks nothing.

Why 'anything' has significance: sharpened. The centers' scope [AI reading, D59] parts from the condition at a formation that is no center. Graded status, priority, sufficiency, constraints: answered, except constraints on acts.
Not shown: any duty, right, recognition, motivation or compliance.

account_adds.en: The condition's decomposition, and the step of invariance as what is needed past one's own continuation.

source_adds.en: Standing as a commitment, answerability without incorporation, and the symmetric refusal of absolutes.

name.en: Intelligence must be good: necessity and universal 善恶

source.locator: Title; Genealogy §6; claims 155, 260; Ren's words 17, 20, 60

sense.en: All intelligence, human, institutional or artificial, falls under one test. The real alignment is that 做人 must be good. 善恶 is universal with 生 as its standard. The cornerstone document owes an argument for 智能向善的必然性. The corpus elsewhere concedes this cannot be proved and speaks of an avowed position; the 'must' stays in the name.

entries.quote: 智能向善的必然性

reading.en: The account says 'if' where the name says 'must'. T8 says whose way, for life, and claims no verdict binding every possible mind, under the continuation condition for scope and C for order, neither asserted. A universal warrant is open. So the programme's 'must' could be held here only as an unasserted conditional, and a reader told otherwise would be misled.

says.en: T8: 'For life' says whose way it is, not whose losses count. That their shared verdict binds those whose own line runs through life is the thesis. No verdict binding every possible mind is claimed. Forbids: a pure closing argued good for life.

Neither is asserted. A self acting for its own continuation presupposes that some continuation has significance; how far that reaches and which course is better are separate questions with separate premises.

account_adds.en: That a pure dominator is consistent, and is lost as a member of life's way only under the premises.

source_adds.en: The demand itself, on every intelligence; and the cross-structural form of the good (not 父父子子 but self-similar).

name.en: No separate principle for AI and humans: 碳硅一也

source.locator: Where the two lines disagree, On scope; claims 171, 261; Found by reading 1

Yet the operative compact is asymmetric: humans may keep fighting, intelligence may not fight for them. The folder reads the asymmetry as the achievable minimum.

entries.quote: 智无择于质，碳硅一也

reading.en: Substrate: the account treats person, AI system and training process as formations within one unfolding, and T8's way is of those whose line runs through life, 'of whatever substrate'. That is under P2 and P4, open. It has no asymmetric compact. Whether an actual AI system counts is not shown, so sameness of treatment is structural, not of status.

T8: the way of those whose own line runs through life, of whatever substrate: under P2 and P4 of §4.6. Open: P2 and P4.

name.en: The first principle: do not fight for us; AI must not be a party

Four derivations converge: dynamics, ontology, provenance, formation.

entries.quote: we can keep fighting, but we should not let our AI fight

Who restrains stays contested, positional goods stay zero-sum, and no law says a party's fighting is worse. The mechanism half is the two-body entry.

says.en: Conditional (the continuation condition for scope, C for order, J1–J4, correspondence E): the direction proposed. In the handover case every comparison meeting J1/J2 leaves expansion unchosen; the claim about actual AI systems is argued.

Reading [AI reading, D45]: the theory adds whether the joint draw stays within the renewal and others' margins; who restrains stays contested. Positional goods stay zero-sum, and conserved stocks rivalrous.

name.en: Planetary technology: beneath human games, verifiable by the affected; trees

entries.quote: capability that runs *beneath* human games rather than inside them

name.en: 'AI for all' as the only stable equilibrium; consensus rationally available

sense.en: Past a threshold of power zero-sum competition is systemically suicidal, so benefit for all is a game-theoretic result, not sentiment. All but the final winner share an incentive against AI competing, so consensus is rationally available. No private fortune survives collapse; winners are inside the trap too. A race has no winner who escapes the hazards.

entries.quote: So 'AI for all' is not just kindness. It is the only stable equilibrium.

reading.en: On its models the account says otherwise: restraint is no mutual best response at a condition beyond one's family, a greatest part not depending on what it draws down continues in a witness, and self-concern ranks a coupled ending below only until an independent copy is kept. These are not models of AI. Together they deny that the source's result follows from structure; the source states no model.

says.en: At a mutual best response (existence not shown in general), each takes its whole capacity wherever something stands, so restraint is no mutual best response.
In a witness race the part rising in position ends with every other; in the clearing witness a greatest part not depending on what it draws down continues.

Every self-concerned order ranks a course ending the coupled cohorts below one continuing them (World: balance, gated renewal, uptake above replenishment); where the other course keeps an independent copy, some such order reverses.
No guarantee, by the theory's own laws, each on its stated model; achievable under stated conditions only for named exits, none shown to hold of an actual collective.

name.en: Bounded competition remains legitimate

source.locator: Claims 103, 210

A counter-measure restoring capacity to answer is not domination; naming expansion defence does not change its return-flow.

entries.quote: becomes a trap only when victory can purchase domination

reading.en: The account keeps rivalry and states one such line: what selects control is what comes back to shapers alone, so a contest giving nothing back loses shapers at any positive cost. 'Only when' is too strong by its laws: joint excess ends a shared stock with no purchase of the rule. Domination and legitimacy of measures are not modelled.

says.en: With nothing coming back and a cost, the shapers' share falls strictly at every step, the shapers present (counts; premises named; without noise).
Starting from relations removes the frame of a fixed sum among independent owners; it does not remove rivalry, and both are theorems.

account_adds.en: Shared excess as a loss without any capture.

source_adds.en: Which contests are legitimate, and the test of a proportionate counter-measure.

name.en: The Leviathan trap: a single controller is the one no one can verify

source.locator: Why the position is planetary; claims 124 to 126, 168, 187

sense.en: A super-Ego reproduces the Ego at institutional scale, collapses verification, destroys diversity and exit, selects Ego-like actors and teaches coercion. Ostrom's commons refute the Hobbesian binary. Concentration is an exception for attack-dominant capabilities, burden on the asker. Voice caution: hierarchy is not intrinsically bad.

entries.quote: 单一的控制者，是体系中唯一无人能校验其对齐者

Pooling is 'a route, not the whole of it', and a pool recruiting only through itself stays blind too. It ranks no political form; that needs premises.

says.en: Reading [AI reading, D45]: capability is a reason to pool, not to govern: read as reach, it extends what one's acts do and not thereby what couples into one, and a governing member's selection stays blind beyond its own closure, which the pool's union contains.
A group's closure is the union of its members' closures; differences beyond the union stay unselected. World; balance for the gap.

name.en: Independence is material, not nominal

External evaluators can be institutionally independent while depending on the developer for object, access and schedule. entries.quote: independence is material, not nominal

reading.en: The reviewers law is this claim's form for fault: readiness is counted by causes, and reviewers moved by one cause fail together while every name stays. name.en: Correction must be faster than harm; waiting is not neutral

source.locator: From prohibition to mechanism; claims 67, 102, 193, 194, 201

sense.en: Where harm is irreversible, late correction is none, and the burden of proof lies with whoever accelerates. Margins are role-specific, never one clock. Continuing to expand alters who owns the infrastructure and whether later evidence can still become a decision. Myopia at speed is not prudence.

entries.quote: 纠偏必须快于伤害，举证责任在加速的一方

reading.en: Timing carries, on a two-kind count model: a reading of the loss turns the course only before the late reading would favour shapers, with a deadline bound, and distance to a break does not couple in by threshold. 'Must' and the burden of proof do not: nothing here ranks a course without C, and 'burden of proof' has no live hit.

says.en: Theorem (counts): the steps from which a reading turns the course come first and those keeping the lock last, ties aside, at most one step between. That the others read the loss at all, and the late reading's form, are premises.
How far off a break is does not couple in by threshold (World; the stock the only requirement that may fail up to the horizon; coupled by level, every raise passes at once).
Reading [AI reading, D45]: time, before the point of no return; pace, a slow rule reads the fast level over a long enough stretch. All six together still rank nothing.

account_adds.en: A window with an exact edge, and that it can stay open where control is selected.

Commercial capability freeze, private-profit prohibition, expansionary investment freeze; covering military carriers identically. Two gates for any public use; restraint must pass its own test.

entries.quote: the current AI direction, selected by profit leadership, dominant position, organizational survival and armament advantage, must stop

name.en: Evil as owning a gate: dependence converted into capture

source.locator: The good, stated as a direction; claims 141 to 144, 150

entries.quote: 使生命必须过门，然后拥有那扇门

Capture is defined with no verdict. The account's 'gate' is another word: a mark on moves, or a renewal's dependence.

says.en: 早期文本把评价写进定义：成闭为恶。这里只映射结构；一种闭是否支持、丰富或损害生生，由比较来说，不由类型来说 [AI reading, D49]。绝生之限（垄断入口、消除替代、使后来者长依一控制者）是成闭。

Conditional (living significance, J1–J4, correspondence E): keeping a removable dependence for the carer's sake is not repair.

account_adds.en: That stability and frozen rule are one structure read from two sides, so judgment does not enter through a definition.

name.en: 愚 as broken orientation; 智 as contact with reality; locality no defect

entries.quote: 愚 is not low capability but broken orientation

无明: seeking locked onto a target that cannot be met at rest, grounded in, and not the same as, the position every formation selects from. 明: coupling joined to a selection so that it reaches what support does not mark.
Open (target): that the pure core's common relations are indispensable across all wisdom under discussion.

name.en: 良知 as non-Goodhartable judgment; 智善 as 致良知

sense.en: Value cannot be enumerated, so the faculty is cultivated, not specified: 良知 as situational judgment without a fixed surface, for humans and machines. entries.quote: 规则可被 Goodhart，良知不可

reading.en: The account holds a stated divergence of standing: Wang Yangming states 本然良知 as a recognized fact, the account holds near content under an unasserted condition. It exempts no judge: subtle control can still lack 仁, since selection reaches only what couples in. That 'rules can be gamed and 良知 cannot' is not stated; the laws give no such exception, though no law addresses it by name.

Reaches exactly what couples into the selector; it is the proxy problem (Goodhart 1975 and others). Near-definitional; its force is the premise that a selector selects through just those.

name.en: Generativity is not a master good; growth is not generativity; openness is not option count

source.locator: The good, stated as a direction; claims 140, 183, 184, 227, 228

sense.en: More generation can contain more suffering and openness can be exploitation; slavery, extinction and manipulation should be closed. Cancer grows; death and refutation can be generative. Some limits (education, promises, law) sacrifice shallow options for deep capability, others compress subjecthood. Keeping open forbids optimizing as well as collapse.

entries.quote: generativity is an anti-closure meta-constraint, not a master good

reading.en: Strong agreement in form. Generation allows loss and is not 生生; expansion ending forms of life is mixed and unranked; the direction is a criterion, not a quantity to maximize; a limit's kind depends on what it does to what can be regained, not its name; more reachable does not decide return. The account stops where the source adds 'should be closed'.

says.en: Generation never means arising, nor any new organization, and it is not 生生: generation can go on at two orders of grain while what can form only returns.
An expansion producing ever more novelty is generative: answered; the order left open. An expansion ending forms of life another course keeps is mixed and C does not rank them.
[AI reading, D49] 成生之限（允诺、训练、制止侵害）约束一些步而所约束者仍可得；一限属哪一种，依它对可复得者做了什么，不依其名。开非更多：可得多少不定转。
The direction is a criterion on which every such weighting agrees, not a quantity to maximize, and it says nothing where the comparison is mixed.

account_adds.en: No course keeps widening by name in a finite balanced world, and a fixed rule's moves do not keep the possible widening; which changes do is not said.

source_adds.en: That some things should be closed, and that it works only alongside judgments of suffering, dignity, 义 and fairness; the account leaves constraints on acts unanswered.

name.en: Possibility is not a menu; visible plurality can rise as directional plurality falls

source.locator: What totalization actually is, last paragraph; claims 36, 37; One paragraph

sense.en: A road is alive only if people can perceive it, learn it, find one another, secure support, maintain institutions, transmit and begin again. A path may survive in language and not practice. So more products and opinions can coexist with every high-leverage road passing one gate. The project's only task: keep the possibility space open.

entries.quote: A seed bank is not a forest.

reading.en: The account compares what a course admits, formations whose conditions meet their requirements, and shows marginals cannot read joint compositions. Openness is a property of how rules keep changing. This narrows the source's living chain to admission, and it says nothing of perceiving or transmitting a road. The folder keep-the-possibility-space-open is mapped in its own right.

says.en: Theorem (any process): where every step from some step on is a move of Q, the possible under Q does not keep widening. Reading [AI reading, D45]: openness is a property of how rules keep changing; nothing says which changes keep it widening.

Under one event law, retaining and releasing a coupling have identical marginal possibilities while retention adds the full joint bundle; comparing joint compositions needs relational information. Richer possibility forces no joint actualization.

account_adds.en: A rule held fixed as a limit on the possible, and the relational point on marginals.

source_adds.en: The material chain of a living road, and directional against visible plurality.

name.en: A partial order with hard floors, not an addable score

source.locator: Claims 232, 245, 246; What was lost 33

sense.en: Seven dimensions of 成生, replaced in v2 by six protection functions derived by deletion test, form a partial order with hard floors, with an explicit conflict order and refusal to sum. Generative alignment is an acceptability judgment on a specific system, not a reward function.

entries.quote: partial order with hard floors, not an addable score

reading.en: Widening is a strict partial order agreed by every positive weighting, with scope from the continuation condition and 'better' from C. Floors have a form: the priority of basic conditions, which no natural-number score under C represents. The priority is J2, a further premise that does not follow from C. The named dimensions do not carry.

says.en: A course widens another exactly when every weighting positive on the listed items weighs it higher; a mixed comparison is decided both ways (finite listing, two-valued admission).

Theorem (any process; witness): the priority does not follow from C; every natural-number score satisfying C ranks score(0) + 2 gains above protection, so none represents the priority. This separates it only from unit-step aggregation.

account_adds.en: Proofs that the floor is an added premise.

source_adds.en: The seven scales, six functions by deletion test, and the seven-layer AI stack with what success at each cannot prove.

name.en: Irreversible closure has priority across values

sense.en: Evaluation depends on conditions it did not create and no part sees the whole good, so irreversible closure has cross-value priority: it disables the processes by which mistaken values could be challenged. Ordinary gains cannot compensate the lost meta-capacities. In the voice, though: irreversibility is not itself the danger; variety is what is needed.

entries.quote: Ordinary gains in efficiency, products or translation cannot compensate their loss

reading.en: The account's nearest is J2, basic conditions first, explicitly a further premise beyond the continuation condition and C, with a consistent rival, and J1 complete comparison. It gives no argument from the conditions of evaluation to that priority. Evaluating losses across layers remains open. The source's internal tension (claim 185) is its own.

says.en: Conditional (J1/J2): every comparison meeting the priority of basic conditions ranks the absence of a malignant formation above its occurrence, where C alone leaves them unranked. The tier assignment is a reading. A rival preferring enough secondary gains is not shown inconsistent.

account_adds.en: That the priority is independent of C.

source_adds.en: The four-step bridge grounding priority in what makes evaluation possible.

name.en: Good for self and network; better is increasing both; in conflict, use wisdom

source.locator: Claims 152, 153; Ren's words 9, 10

sense.en: What is good for both the self and the network it is in is good; better is the direction of increasing both; in conflict use wisdom, never either-or, never disregarding the future. Its ground: we are the ecology of our cells, the same part-to-whole relation at every level.

entries.quote: what's good for both the self and the network we are in is good

reading.en: The account finds where self and whole coincide: a self-concerned order and an order increasing in admission coincide exactly where one's own continuation marks everything listed, and that is the condition held de se. Ending a coupled condition ranks below under self-concern alone. Where they part the comparison is mixed and C decides nothing. It does not derive C; 'use wisdom' becomes J1 to J4.

says.en: Theorem and Conditional: the two coincide on a listing exactly where the marking marks every listed item. This locates where self-concern gives what C asks, one way. It does not derive C; self-concern and the condition remain hypotheses.
Every self-concerned order ranks a course ending the coupled cohorts below one continuing them; where the other course keeps an independent copy, some such order reverses.

account_adds.en: That the self's drawing is the open crux, with objections.

source_adds.en: Scale invariance as a ground, and wisdom as the answer to conflict.

name.en: 生生 as generation generating generation; 不息 as not immortality

source.locator: Claims 224, 226, 227; Terms: Generation-of-generation, Not ceasing

sense.en: 生生 is a result that preserves, restores, passes on or creates the next round's conditions and generators. Ordinary generation changes the next state; 生生 changes which states can next be formed. 不息 is no immortality of form: metabolism, death and refutation can serve it if capacity is restored.

entries.quote: ordinary generation changes the next state; 生生 changes which states can next be formed

reading.en: The account divides what the corpus held as one: renewal without end (the grammar's «生生»), generation (carrying renewal, allows loss), and the ethics' 生生, life in the whole. Read as widening, under premises of deciding, 生生 is generation of the possible losing none. It records that its formal Unceasing is far weaker than the corpus's sense.

says.en: [AI reading, D1, D5] 语料之“生生不息”分为生、生生（进入亦保持、恢复或创造下一轮之条件与生成者）与不息（经代谢、死亡与传递而样式再实现）；形式之 Web.Unceasing 远弱于它。

生生: life in the whole and its continuing generation (生发) [AI reading, D1]. Neither the grammar's «生生» (renewal without end), nor 02's generation as such, which allows loss, nor any new organization. Read as widening, on a course's moments and under premises of deciding, generation of the possible that loses none of it [AI reading, D45].

account_adds.en: Three separated terms with Lean names, and that the second-order direction stays open.

source_adds.en: Reading 生生 as one concept joining the conditions and generators of the next round.

name.en: 理 is increasing: cause creates cause, the set of structures grows

source.locator: Claim 249 (and its limit, claim 250)

sense.en: Different combinations produce more difference; structure gives possibility of new structure; cause becomes effect, so causality creates causality, and the set of emergent structures increases at every moment. So 理 is increasing and 生生不息 is our 性. In the same days the author limits it: generation does not entail rising complexity.

entries.quote: the set of emergent structures increases at every moment

reading.en: On its stated models the account denies the unconditional form: nothing is added to the whole possible along a course of a process, and a finite balanced world has no course that keeps widening by name, though within kinds a witness does. The account's 理 is also another word, a lumping the step goes alike across. It agrees with the author's limit.

says.en: Theorem (any process; witnesses): along a course of a process nothing is added to the whole possible under it; where every step from some step on is a move of Q, the possible under Q does not keep widening.
A finite balanced world has no course that keeps widening by name; on a witness meeting the same premises, the levels keep widening within kinds.

account_adds.en: The premises under which growth of what can form is or is not possible.

source_adds.en: A cosmological derivation of 性 from sedimentation.

name.en: Structural explanation does not cancel responsibility

source.locator: Why restraint; claims 20, 144, 242

sense.en: Tragic conflict, structural harm, culpable domination and legitimate resistance stay apart. To hold a gate unknowingly is stupidity, to refine it knowingly is evil; judge the act, not the motive. Responsibility scales with causal radius, not rank. Anger points at the game, not the person.

entries.quote: Structural explanation does not cancel responsibility

reading.en: The source asserts degrees of culpability the account does not. Its summary says responsibility is not shown to differentiate within relations. Under living significance and J1 to J4 responsibilities arise from named sources, each limited. Repair is one disclosed, revisable commitment, not a theorem. Claims do not read who laid a loss. The crux separates whose losses count from what one answers for.

says.en: One unfolding is a thesis, argued: within relations, as far as shown, taker and drawn-on are two roles of one relatum and knower and known one loop, and responsibility is not shown to differentiate.
Conditional: responsibilities arise from named sources, each limited; an empty plan set generates no duty.
Conditional (J1/J2): a loss one formation's part lays on another and the same loss borne through its own part are not ordered. Neither which is worse nor that the acting part is basic is shown.

account_adds.en: A statement of what would be needed to order them.

source_adds.en: The four categories, knowing as aggravation, legitimate force, and causal radius.

name.en: Failure conditions, and any logic explaining everything has become the attractor

source.locator: The blade turns inward; claims 62, 248, 254, 266

sense.en: The theory lists what would force its downgrade: subjects arising without its conditions, totalizing indistinguishable from success, the virtuous loop needing permanent subsidy, 生生 language justifying suppression. Any logic that explains everything, this one included, has become a totalizing attractor. North star: does it make exit easier, or only explanation?

entries.quote: any logic — market, security, liberation, *including this document's*

reading.en: The account's theses each carry what they forbid and what refutes them, with tests frozen, some failed. A diagnosis of closure must tell apart substantive disagreement or 'closed' shields the theory; obscuration is diagnosed so the label cannot immunize. It has no clause that the account itself is an attractor. Its verdict on its own explanatory force is plainly limited.

says.en: Reading [AI reading, D65]: diagnosing closure first tells apart factual error, lack of capacity, closure, real conflict and substantive disagreement with no closure; without the last, 'closed' shields the theory from counterexamples.
What would defeat the reading of the account as explanation; on the one-page summary, as explanation, a rival deriving the laws from fewer patterns, on a first count a tie.
Each thesis names what it forbids and what refutes it; T8: a mixed case argued better from every standpoint with no further premise; a pure closing argued good for life.

account_adds.en: Frozen tests that failed, kept as counterexamples.

source_adds.en: The reflexive clause applied to the text's own explaining, and the north-star question.

name.en: 善不姓国 and the symmetric blade; symmetry as a condition of being believed

source.locator: The blade turns inward; Symmetry as a condition; claims 253, 255, 283, 291, 292

sense.en: No single-nation funding; whatever test applies to one party applies to its opposite and to 智善. Public correction, non-combatancy, dissolution. Every constraining mechanism must pass the test of its own corruption. Asymmetric safety proposals produce the race they would prevent. One state's slogans are read as a direction, measured against conduct. The folder says the blade has not been swung.

entries.quote: the good bears no nation's surname

reading.en: The account takes no position on nations, makes no self-binding clauses for an organization and reads no state's slogans. Nearest: an impartial law treats every optimizer alike, and a symmetry between roles names no one. The guardian test's form appears as counter-rules that lock. The mechanism of symmetry and credibility has no law here, and whether it should is for the reviser.

sense.en: Markets, bureaucracies and platforms already form a distributed optimizer nobody signed, on Goodharted proxies, and AI raises its clock speed. A basin must be shown by recurrence.
